title: WhatsApp Chat Processed Dialog
description: Schema for a processed WhatsApp dialog including messages, summary, and extracted entities.

dialog_id.description: Unique identifier for the dialog session.

messages.description: List of messages within the dialog.

role.description: Role of the message sender (e.g., client, agent, participant).

text.description: The actual text content of the message.

intent.description: Detected intent from the message text (optional).

entities.description: Extracted entities from the message text (e.g., dates, numbers). Could be key-value pairs or a more structured object.

summary.description: A brief summary of the dialog.

topics.description: Key topics discussed in the dialog.

final_request.description: The final user request or concluding part of the dialog, if identifiable.
